answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 152439 Country: USA Title: Providing services to SIKH Yatries Question: I am a travel agent, I need to ask if I provide transportation and accommodation services to Sikh Yatris in Pakistan who will travel to Pakistan from USA for visit to their Sacred places in Pakistan. I will have nothing to do with any of their religious activities. We just have to provide them transportation to their destinations, accommodation and take them to markets for shopping and some Pakistani cultural places. All this activity is beneficial as tourism business in Pakistan, I need to know if such business would be halal or haram? Answer ID: 152439 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1262/1187/SN=11/1438) In the question mentioned above you may provide transport and accommodation facility to the Sikh tourists and if they perform a task of kufr and shirk during the journey you shall not be sinful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
